summary_en: The caller, Kiran, initiated the call expressing that the proposed 3 kW system was too expensive. The agent explained the post-subsidy cost of ₹1,17,000 and offered a monthly EMI option of ₹2,999 for 48 months. After the caller confirmed the EMI amount, he agreed to proceed and requested a free survey. He provided his name as Kiran, stated his locality as Velachery, and requested the survey to be scheduled for Saturday. The agent confirmed saving these details and promised that the team would contact him to arrange the Saturday survey. The caller thanked the agent, and the call ended.
